definitions.explanation: The angular distance of a place east or west of the prime meridian, measured in degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{経度|けいど}135⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{標準|ひょうじゅん}{時|じ}→標準時：18871_hyoujunji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子午線|しごせん}→子午線：26054_shigosen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Japan uses 135 degrees longitude as the standard meridian.

examples.japanese: ⟦GPS→GPS：08842_jiipiiesu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{経度|けいど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{緯度|いど}→緯度：03978_ido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: I checked the longitude and latitude with GPS.

examples.japanese: {経度|けいど}0⟦{度|ど}→度：09845_do⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本初|ほんしょ}{子午線|しごせん}→本初子午線：noentry⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: The line at 0 degrees longitude is called the prime meridian.

notes:
GEOGRAPHY:
- ⟦{東経|とうけい}→東経：10004_toukei⟧ (east longitude)
- ⟦{西経|せいけい}→西経：26196_seikei⟧ (west longitude)
- {経度|けいど}0⟦{度|ど}→度：09845_do⟧ (0 degrees longitude - prime meridian)
- ⟦{本初|ほんしょ}{子午線|しごせん}→本初子午線：noentry⟧ (prime meridian - Greenwich)

PAIR WORD:
- ⟦{緯度|いど}→緯度：03978_ido⟧ (latitude)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {経度|けいど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{緯度|いど}→緯度：03978_ido⟧ (longitude and latitude)
- ⟦{経緯|けいい}→経緯：02782_keii⟧ (longitude and latitude - abbreviated form; also means 'circumstances')

HISTORY: The measurement of longitude was a significant challenge in navigation history. Japan adopted the international standard with the prime meridian at Greenwich in 1886.

NOTE: Japan spans from approximately 122°E to 154°E longitude.
